_comment: SHA-256 digests of the DER certificates Roblox signs com.roblox.client with.
This list is what makes installing from a mirror acceptable: a mirror can
serve any bytes it likes, and it cannot forge Roblox's signing key. A digest
is public information -- anyone can compute it from a genuine Roblox APK with
an APK signature inspection tool -- so this file is an audit record, not a
It is a file rather than a constant so it can be read, diffed and updated
without a release. If Roblox rotates its signing certificate, downloads fail
closed until a digest is added here, which is the right direction to fail and
Adding a digest is a decision, not a chore: each entry is a key rusty-blox
will accept builds from permanently. Take it from an APK you already trust
and record where it came from.
The list is scoped to the Android phone package; other packages need their

certificates.note: Taken from a genuine Google Play build (2.734.0.917) and cross-checked with an independent v2 signing-block parse before being recorded here.
